fusions.name: Course After Course
fusions.desc: Sends a strand to tear a mouthful from a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 8 blood damage. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 30%). Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Passed Around
fusions.desc: Looses 3 feeding strands at once, spread apart, each dealing 10 blood damage. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, and 20% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Bound at One Table
fusions.desc: Ties a strand to every ally within 5 tiles: each strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds and fights with 1 more Power while it holds, and you regain 8 health.

fusions.name: Ten Thousand Mouths
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your strands feed on the remains: for 6 seconds you heal for 25% of the damage you deal. Once every 12 seconds.
